title: COP31 climate talks end without consensus on how to fund vulnerable countries or move the world away from coal, oil and gas use
summary: After two weeks of tough talks, the COP31 climate summit has closed without a consensus on how to quit fossil fuels or fund countries struggling to adapt to a hotter world.

title: Germany news: IG Metall union calls for new 24-hour strike
summary: Germany's biggest single union, IG Metall, is calling on car and shipyard workers to strike amid a pay row. Meanwhile, Germany's president is setting off on an Africa trip. DW has more.

title: Inspired by Bernie Sanders: A German agency is using US-Style campaigning to boost the left in 2029
summary: "The Goodforces" wants to see a swing to the left in the 2029 German elections. The agency counts New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Bernie Sanders among its inspirations. Could it transform the political landscape?
